what: WORKED COMPUTATION (independent run 2 of 2): Where memory should appear, by dimension, in the simplest approximations. (2) Gaussian (spin-wave) correction: m ~ 1 - sigma^2 G_d with G_d the plane return sum (infinite for d <= 2, finite for d >= 3: compute G_3 for both neighbourhoods numerically to 4 digits by FFT extrapolation in L, and with rigorous brackets if you can).
